instruction: Would you play this streaming media URL with VLC? https://mnmedias.api.telequebec.tv/m3u8/29880.m3u8

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires streaming a media URL in VLC. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric. Same complexity as original task - simple URL streaming.
metadata.verification_notes: Reuses existing VLC evaluator functions. Similar streaming task with different URL source.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies both that VLC is playing and that the correct URL is being played
Robust URL matching: Metric implements multiple matching strategies suitable for HLS streaming URLs (direct match, filename extraction, domain/path comparison)
Correct parameter handling: Metric function correctly accesses rule dictionary parameters (rule['type'], rule['url']) without incorrect expected.get('rules') patterns
Practical feasibility: Getter successfully extracts VLC status via HTTP interface, metric can parse XML and verify state
Good edge case handling: Handles cases where VLC is not playing, URL info is missing, or HLS streams show only filename instead of full URL
Semantic correctness: The evaluator logic directly verifies the instruction requirement to play the specified streaming media URL
